title: Pope Leo XIV accepts Jaucian’s resignation as Bangued bishop

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Pope Leo XIV has accepted the resignation of Bishop Leopoldo Jaucian, ending his nearly 19-year leadership of the Diocese of Bangued in Abra. The Vatican announced the decision on Saturday, Nov. 7. Jaucian, 66, was appointed bishop of Bangued by Pope Benedict XVI on Jan. 5, 2007. He received episcopal ordination on March 26
